text: 离岸稍远处，一股淡淡的硫磺臭味从狭窄峡谷的入口飘出。你读到过汉尼纳地区可能有温泉。正式发现它们的诱惑实在难以抗拒。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 11
text: A little back from the shore, the faint stench of sulfur wafts out of the mouth of a narrow canyon. You have read about possible hot springs in the Hanninah region. It is very tempting to formally discover them.
